name: Save The Doge
storyline:
Bee is evil. The dog is in danger.
Your mission is simple—use your creativity, draw a line, and save the pet within 10 seconds!
Welcome to Save The Pets—a fun and creative animal rescue game where your imagination saves lives. Bees are the only evil, and your mission is to draw the perfect line to protect the dog from their attack.
summary: Are you ready for a heart warming puzzle challenge? In Save My Pet: Draw & Rescue, you’ll use your brain and creativity to rescue cute dogs and pets! Draw lines to save pets from danger, solve tricky puzzles, and become the hero in this animal rescue saga.
